newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market poorly tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market poorly tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were poorly tested, few sales steady, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade light. Demand light. Seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lb few 72.00-73.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1175 lb few 72.00.
Ona caarcass basis (weight only), compared to Wednesday close, slaughter steers and heifers were poorly tested, few sales about steady.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs few 115.00-116.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 103.00-104.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 106.00-107.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 101.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs few 115.00-116.00.
